# Acquiring an arbitrary source from approximate nonnegative predictive width

30 October 2026. NEW proposed statistical principle; whole challenge pending.
The frozen exact-rank compiler and sample-only operation are consumed at their
accepted scopes without changing their bytes, algorithms or experimental data.
No new source instance, optimizer, learner or benchmark has been run.

## 1. Consequence and input

An exact finite predictive-rank promise is inappropriate for many scientific
sources. The compiler can instead have a model budget r and an oracle inequality
for arbitrary truth P. It need not receive, evaluate or sample a low-rank shadow,
know its approximation error, or force the shadows at different cuts to define
one coherent global generative model.

P,Q are arbitrary fixed laws on [O]^T, O>=2,T>=1. Inputs remain iid FULL P
trajectories and fresh iid conditional Q future samples at positive-Q prefixes.
No probability VALUE service, P conditional/likelihood, supplied KL bound,
target singular gap, or TRUE rank(P) bound is supplied. The integer r>=1 is a
model budget. Ordinary rational input length, source queries, returned symbols,
conditional/reset acquisition and fair-bit/arithmetic costs are paid as in the
accepted sample-only construction. Source sampling is not passive P data alone.

For a cut t with prefix law P_t and future law p_h=P(.|h), define w_r(P) by the
following FINITE-DIMENSIONAL EXISTENCE optimization. Choose at each cut an
arbitrary family of PROBABILITY vectors s_(t,h), one for each P-positive prefix,
whose linear span has dimension<=r. No consistency across cuts is required.
Set

    e_t = E_(h~P_t) ||p_h-s_(t,h)||_1,
    w_r(P) = min_(all such families) max_(1<=t<T) e_t.    (1)

For T1 take w_r(P)=0. These witnesses are not oracle inputs. The minimum exists:
at each cut the product of finitely many probability simplexes is compact,
the rank<=r constraint is closed by vanishing minors, and the finite weighted
L1/max objective is continuous. The feasible set is nonempty (one uniform row
for every prefix). The width lies in[0,2] and is0 exactly when every true
predictive cut has rank<=r. It is a quantitative approximation to that property,
not a positive hidden-state count or a supplied latent realization.

Let A0=ceil[10000(r+O+T+1/delta)], kappa=1/131072. The proposed SAME completed

Root whole-read the proof and reconstructed the complete transfer into the

Constructive overlap is explicit: T proposed the global shadow transfer; root

substantive whole analytical challenge with disclosed participation, not a claim

## Structural resource and acquisition

At each fixed cut, a probability-row family s_h of span at most r is indexed by
actual P-positive prefixes. The sampling law for h is P; its function value s_h
need not be P's conditional row. Sample compression conditions on fixed index
subsets of those iid function values, so the original population argument still
works. One never samples from a shadow or propagates its children.

I reconstructed the two key moments:

    E_P ||p_h-R_h||_1^2<=2 D(P||R),
    E_P ||p_h-s_h||_1^2<=2 e_t,
    E_P ||R_h-s_h||_1^2<=4 D(P||R)+4 e_t.

Thus replacing the old raw-row error by 2[D(P||R)+max e_t] pays its entire
all-NT-rows Markov event. Under d+w_r(P)<=x^(-16384), the empirical teacher bound
and the supplied constants give that quantity<=x^(-4096), with ample slack.
The hidden row matrix now has rank<=r. Every subsequent rational truncation,
spanner and L1 sketch statement uses exactly that fact; it does not need its
rows to be conditionals of one process.

Nonnegativity and mass1 of s_h are substantive. They pay the existing padded
proxy positivity argument and coefficient normalization. No signed or unnormalized
shadow family is being smuggled into that step.

# Prior and capability boundary for the arbitrary-source extension

30 October 2026. This supplements the NEW proposed proof without editing any
frozen accepted source. No benchmark, source data or solver run is added.

## Strongest consumed operations

Liu--Moitra, arXiv2411.07536v1, Theorem1.3 and §§3--7, is the constructive
same-target low-probability-rank/conditional-query predecessor. Its empirical
probability trees, density-mixture sketches, barycentric geometry, robust
truncation and KL convex inference are established machinery. The accepted
misspecified-teacher compiler and sample-only/unknown-KL compositions are the
immediate reusable inputs. Their reviewed source bytes, complete algebraic
assumptions and finite resource qualifications are retained in their own frozen
folders. The new argument is not a new spanner, KL identity or model-selection
principle.

Kakade--Krishnamurthy--Mahajan--Zhang, COLT2023/PMLR195, arXiv2302.14753, defines
the same-target conditional access and exact predictive-rank class. Its sample
theorem uses the fidelity resource; exact-value learning has a different access
contract. I checked its abstract, definitions and controlling theorem framing
from the official proceedings PDF. It is a real constructive ordinary comparator,
not a source for relabelling arbitrary Q as conditional P. No broad claim that
all agnostic or robust low-rank learning is new is made.

The current extension permits a hidden nonnegative low-rank row family at EACH
cut under ACTUAL P-prefix sampling. These families enter only the existence
and sample-compression/geometry proof. The full KL propagation always uses P
and the teacher's joint restrictions. This changes the exact-truth promise;
it is not a numerical budget/exponent improvement. Classical linear widths,
approximate rank and oracle inequalities are established mathematical notions;
historical priority of this particular conditional-teacher operation is UNKNOWN.
